## 5. What the record still lacks

- The Partition-Subdivision Agreement itself (Doc. 402/Pg. 81/Bk. CXXII) and the Asis registers: never produced to the family; the Registry file for its entry holds only the plan.

- Who presented the 2021 instruments and surrendered the 2017 duplicate (Primary Entry Book).

- The DENR file: who signed as the owners' representative on 8 Sep 2020, three years after Cesar died.

- Dated proof of each structure (permits or a no-record certification; building declarations; imagery).

- Patricia's testimony (rebuttal); a peso figure for the use of the lot; Cesar's PSA death certificate; the Civil Case 8563 complaint and docket; a legal memo on imputing an agent's or counsel's knowledge to the principal (the 9 Jul 2021 notice).

- Records of who actually held Llamanzares contracts (the 1977 "Deeds of Final Sale" on T-4497; any Agcaoili office or Violeta ledger).
